utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Mara, did you hear about the repair drive this Saturday? They're fixing up the old community center!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh yes, Tess! I've been talking to folks around the neighborhood—Jules mentioned a lot are pitching in, and Gus even has his tool kit ready.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That's great to hear, Mara! It's wonderful so many people are joining in. I'll be there bright and early with some snacks for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds like a good thing, but I'm pretty swamped this weekend. What's the deal?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, it's a real neighborhood thing — I've heard from a bunch of folks that they're jumping in, but I'm not sure on the exact start time yet.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Well, I'm probably out then, but let me know if you need a specific tool or something dropped off.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, the repair drive? I've heard a few folks talking about it—seems like Oren is organizing something.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oren? Are we sure he's actually got a plan, or is this just another half-baked idea?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Well, I heard from Jules that there's some buzz about it, but I can't say for sure how solid it is yet.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Leo, have you heard if that repair drive is starting this weekend? I'm trying to sort out the school runs.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Not sure yet, but I've got tools ready if it does.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Well, if you hear anything definite, give me a shout — I don't want to miss it with all the school pickups.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I'm heading over to help Leo with the generator now. Want to come along?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Is this repair drive actually organized, or are we all just showing up and hoping for the best?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: It’s coming together—Leo’s got the tools ready, and I’m heading to help him with the generator right now. Want to lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! I keep meaning to get organized for it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Oren, I was just telling Rosa about it—got a good feeling, everyone's chipping in!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that's great! I hope I haven't forgotten to do anything important...

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey, sorry I'm late. What's the repair drive about again?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: The repair drive is a community effort to fix up the neighborhood—we're settling on a regular morning check-in time. What works for you, Dane?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Mornings are a bit tricky for me, but I can make it work if we settle on a time. What were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I'll grab my alignment tools, Rey. Be right there!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, Gus, hold up—are you heading to the repair drive? I've just heard murmurs about it, but nothing solid yet.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I'm heading over now. Rey said he needs help with the alignment—got my tools ready. Want me to fill you in on the way?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Noah, I'm still trying to piece together what this repair drive actually involves. Do you have any more details?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hmm, I think Vik mentioned something about it, but I'm fuzzy on the specifics. Maybe check with him?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: You're right, I should double-check with Vik. I don't want to show up unprepared.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yeah, I heard about the welding gear too. I'm trying to figure out what else we might need—maybe some lumber or paint for the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, absolutely! I've been telling folks we could use extra paint and lumber—anything helps get that place looking sharp again!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great minds think alike, Quinn! I'll add paint and lumber to the list—let's make sure we've got enough to cover those old walls.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I think Mr. Henson mentioned a sign-up sheet at the community center, but I haven't checked it myself.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, the community center? I saw the repair drive truck on Oak Street earlier—did they end up stopping at the hardware store?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'm not sure, Opal. I haven't been by the hardware store today.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Rosa, I'm just resting today. The drive can wait a bit.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, no rush at all, Uli! Just so you know, we've moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sunday at the center, got it. I'll see if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Mara, I'm still trying to figure out if there's any system in place. Do you know if we're signing up for tasks or just showing up and hoping for the best?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Well, from what Cleo's been tracking, we definitely need specific gear like welding stuff and cables, so I think it's more organized than just showing up—there must be a sign-up or at least a list of what's needed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: So there's a list of gear, but is there a schedule for when we're supposed to show up? I don't want to be the only one there at the wrong time.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'm still trying to figure out how it all works. Mr. Henson mentioned new tools, but I haven't seen them yet.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I'm planning a repair drive this weekend—should be great once everyone gets on board!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, so you're the one organizing it? That explains a lot—I'd like to hear more about what you've got planned.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I've been hearing a bit about it. Do you know what time it starts?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I think it's set to kick off around 9 AM, but I can double-check with Quinn if you need a firmer time.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That would be great, Jules. I'd appreciate a firm time before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I was just telling Quinn about it — the whole neighborhood's supposed to pitch in on Saturday to get the old place spruced up again.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right, the repair drive. I'll try to stop by if I'm free.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You should definitely come, Bo! They could use all the hands they can get, and it'll be a good chance to catch up with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, I might need a wrench. Do you have a good adjustable one?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I've got a solid adjustable wrench. Want me to grab it for you?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, go ahead and grab it. I’ll be at the community center Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Opal! I'm glad you're here. The repair drive's been moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sunday? That's odd—I was sure I saw the truck on Oak Street earlier. Did you hear who's coordinating the move?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I coordinated the change myself—the front porch was getting too cramped with our expected turnout, so the community center offered a better setup.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, the drive's coming together. Need any tools?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Tools, huh? I might have a wrench somewhere... let me dig through my garage—I haven't seen it since last fall.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That'd be a big help, Noah. Thanks for checking.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Ira, you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? We're all getting together to fix up the old community center!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I've been hearing snippets here and there. Sounds like a good thing for the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great! So, are you planning to come by and lend a hand? It's gonna be a fun day.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, Sam! The repair drive — I was just thinking about that. Did you happen to see if anyone was on Oak Street earlier?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I haven't been down Oak Street today, Oren. But I know Eli's free Thursday afternoon if you need to coordinate something.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thursday afternoon, you say? I think I wrote something down about that... or maybe it was Tuesday. I should check my notes.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Rey, speaking of tools, I heard the drive brought in some welding gear too. Might be just what we need to patch up that rusty playground fence.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That's great! Just as long as it doesn't interfere with school pick-up times—I can help if it's in the morning.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Morning works for me, Faye. I'll make sure the welding gear is set aside and ready to go by then.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, Leo, you're saying there's a repair drive this Saturday? Who's actually confirmed they're showing up?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I've got the alignment kit ready. Haven't heard from everyone yet, but Sam said they might help.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So just you and maybe Sam? That's not much of a drive. Is there any organizer or a plan beyond your alignment kit?
